videos.video_plan_es: Plan de montaje dinámico: Hook(Macro) -> Tension(Medium) -> Revelation(Insert) -> Expansion(Wide) -> Impact(Slow-mo)
videos.character_description_en: A young woman, late 20s, with long wavy chestnut hair, piercing green eyes, and subtle freckles. She has a determined yet thoughtful expression, and an athletic, lean build.
videos.clip_1_hook_en: MACRO SHOT. Woman's hand clenching stomach in a cluttered, dim kitchen. Harsh overhead fluorescent light. Pained frustration. Photorealistic, cinematic, 4K. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO TYPOGRAPHY. CLEAN VISUAL ONLY
videos.clip_2_tension_en: MEDIUM SHOT. Woman scrolling intently on tablet at cluttered desk with books. Natural window light. Overwhelmed, searching. Photorealistic, cinematic, 4K. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO TYPOGRAPHY. CLEAN VISUAL ONLY
videos.clip_3_revelation_en: INSERT SHOT. Woman's finger tracing a gut-brain diagram on a minimalist desk. Soft, hopeful lamp light. Revelation, 'Aha!' moment. Photorealistic, cinematic, 4K. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO TYPOGRAPHY. CLEAN VISUAL ONLY
videos.clip_4_expansion_en: WIDE SHOT. Woman confidently chopping colorful vegetables in a sunlit, modern kitchen. Vibrant golden light. Empowered, focused. Photorealistic, cinematic, 4K. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO TYPOGRAPHY. CLEAN VISUAL ONLY
videos.clip_5_impact_en: EPIC SLOW-MOTION CLOSE-UP. Woman exhaling slowly, serene smile, eyes closed on an ocean cliff. Golden Hour light. Profound peace. Photorealistic, cinematic, 4K. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO TYPOGRAPHY. CLEAN VISUAL ONLY
videos.voiceover_en: What if your gut held the key to your mind? A hidden dialogue, shaping your mood, your focus, your very essence. For too long, ignored. But awaken this second brain, and unlock a symphony of well-being. Transform chaos into clarity. Discover the profound connection.
videos.post_text_en:
Feeling foggy or overwhelmed? Your gut might be whispering secrets to your brain you've been missing. Unlock the incredible power of your 'second brain' and transform your daily well-being. From digestion to decision-making, it's all connected. Ready to listen?
